title: Flat shapes and {{term:symmetry}}
summary: Make a {{term:triangle}} and a {{term:square-shape}} on the pinboard, find the triangles, and draw a {{term:line-of-symmetry}}.
guide: This studio is for Year 1. Children draw by tapping dots, so no typing is needed. Read the sentences aloud if your child is not reading yet; the small picture at the top also shows what to do.
The dotty board works like a pinboard and elastic band: each tap joins a new dot to the last one. To finish a shape, tap the first dot again. Undo removes the last dot.

A {{term:triangle}} has three straight {{term:side}}s and three corners, whichever way up it is. A shape that is not closed is not a triangle. A {{term:square-shape}} has four equal sides and four square corners; a {{term:rectangle}} has square corners too, but its sides are not all equal.
A {{term:line-of-symmetry}} is a fold line: fold the shape along it and the two halves match exactly. The diagonal of a rectangle is not a line of symmetry; folding a paper rectangle shows why.

engine.letters: A B C D E F G H I J
engine.instruction-draw: Tap the dots. Then tap the first dot.
engine.instruction-fold: Tap two dots to draw the fold line.

make-triangle.title: Make a triangle
make-triangle.prompt: Draw a {{term:triangle}}. Tap three dots. Then tap the first dot to close it.
make-triangle.hint: A triangle has 3 corners. Choose 3 dots that are not in one straight line.
make-triangle.success: Well done! That is a triangle. It has 3 sides and 3 corners.
make-triangle.why: Why is this shape called a triangle? Count its sides and corners.
make-triangle.model: It has 3 {{term:side}}s and 3 corners. "Tri" means three. Every triangle, big or small, straight or tipped over, has 3 sides and 3 corners.

feedback.empty: Tap the dots to draw a shape.
feedback.open: Your shape is still open. Tap the first dot to close it.
feedback.too-many-sides: Your shape has more than 3 corners. A triangle has only 3. Press Clear and try again.
feedback.too-few-sides: A triangle has 3 corners. You need 3 dots that are not in a straight line.
feedback.crossed: The lines cross over each other. Draw it again.

make-square.title: Make a square
make-square.prompt: Draw a {{term:square-shape}}. All its sides must be the same length.
make-square.hint: Count the gaps between dots. If one side is 2, the other sides must be 2 as well.
make-square.success: Well done! Four equal sides and four square corners. That is a square.
make-square.why: How do you know your shape is a square and not a rectangle?
make-square.model: A square has 4 sides that are all the same length, and its corners are square, like the corner of a book. A rectangle also has square corners, but two of its sides are longer.

feedback.empty: Tap the dots to draw a shape.
feedback.open: Your shape is still open. Tap the first dot to close it.
feedback.not-equal: That is a {{term:rectangle}}: two sides are longer. In a square every side is the same length. Look at the numbers by the sides.
feedback.not-square: That shape has 4 sides, but its corners are not square like the corner of a book. Try again.
feedback.too-many-sides: A square has only 4 corners. Press Clear and try again.
feedback.too-few-sides: A square has 4 corners. You need one more dot.
feedback.crossed: The lines cross over each other. Tap the dots in order, all the way round.

find-triangles.title: Find the triangles
find-triangles.hint: Count the corners of each shape. A triangle has 3 corners and is closed. It can be upside down or long and thin.
find-triangles.success: Well done! You found all three triangles, even the upside-down one and the long thin one.
find-triangles.why: The blue triangle is upside down. Is it still a triangle? Why?
find-triangles.model: Yes. If we turn a shape round, it still has 3 sides and 3 corners. Turning a shape does not change its name.

feedback.open-shape: The yellow shape is not closed: it has a gap. A triangle must be closed.
feedback.round: The red shape is a {{term:circle}}. It has no corners. A triangle has 3 corners.
feedback.four-sides: The green shape has 4 corners. A triangle has only 3.
feedback.extra: One of the shapes you tapped is not a triangle. Count its corners. Tap it again to take it away.
feedback.missed: There is another triangle. Triangles can be upside down or long and thin.

fold-line.title: The fold line
fold-line.prompt: If we fold this rectangle along one line, the two halves match. Draw that line.
fold-line.hint: The line must cut the shape into two halves that are exactly the same. Go through the middle of the sides, not through the corners.
fold-line.success: Well done! That is a {{term:line-of-symmetry}}: the two halves fold exactly onto each other.
fold-line.why: This rectangle has one more line of symmetry. Where is it?
fold-line.model: One line goes up through the middle, and one goes across through the middle. Both cut the rectangle into two matching halves. A line from corner to corner is not a line of symmetry.

feedback.empty: Tap two dots to draw a line.
feedback.diagonal: That line goes from corner to corner. If you fold a paper rectangle like that, the corners do not meet. Go through the middle of the sides.
feedback.not-symmetry: The two sides of your line are not the same size. The line must go through the middle of the shape.

mirror-house.title: The other half of the house
mirror-house.prompt: The dashed line is a mirror. Draw the other half of the house so both sides match.
mirror-house.hint: The wall is 2 squares away from the dashed line. On the other side, draw it 2 squares away too.
mirror-house.success: Well done! The house is symmetrical. The dashed line is its line of symmetry.
mirror-house.why: How did you know where to draw the wall?
mirror-house.model: In a mirror, every point goes the same distance to the other side of the line. The wall was 2 squares to the left of the dashed line, so I drew it 2 squares to the right.

feedback.empty: Tap the dots to draw the other half.
feedback.slid: You copied the same half. In a mirror the shape is flipped. The roof must reach the dashed line.
feedback.not-image: The two sides do not match yet. Count how far each corner is from the dashed line, and go the same distance on the other side.
